about.page.heading: About
about.page.summary.lead:
I've been working in software for over 05 years now. I enjoy solving problems (in general but mostly using software), making things, and growing teams. I've worked with many different software systems and really enjoy evolving them over time to meet changing needs. I've also done a lot of work on scaling - both increasing throughput and creating processes and automation to make changes safer as the user base grows.
Outside of work, I have a passion for plants (especially bonsai) and crafting wooden furniture for my home.

 Whew, that’s a lot, but I’m genuinely excited to meet everyone and collaborate with new partners!

testimonials.block.footer: Feedback from people I've worked with.
testimonials.block.author: Client feedback
testimonials.block.items.0.name: Joshua Calducchi
testimonials.block.items.0.body:
Mr.Hieu is a reliable engineer who consistently delivers clear value throughout his work. He maintains strong performance, contributes positively to product quality, and has made a lasting impact on the team - even before I joined Poppy.
I truly appreciate everything Hieu has contributed, especially his support during my early days on the team. I'd be happy to be a reference if that's ever helpful, and I look forward to the opportunity to collaborate with him again on future projects.
testimonials.block.items.1.name: Katherine Patton
testimonials.block.items.1.body: Mr. Hieu is a dependable engineer who consistently brings clarity and impact to his work. His positive attitude and collaborative mindset make him a pleasure to work with across teams. He approaches challenges with a solutions-first mindset, maintains strong delivery standards, and contributes to improving efficiency. His ability to balance quality and speed has been valuable on critical projects, and his proactive support has positively influenced both team performance and overall outcomes.
testimonials.block.items.2.name: Dat Giang
testimonials.block.items.2.body: Hieu demonstrates a high level of ownership and professionalism in everything he does. Beyond his technical capabilities, his proactive communication and willingness to support others stand out. He brings a calm, constructive energy to the team, even under pressure, and consistently delivers results that align with business goals. His contributions have had a meaningful impact on both product stability and team culture. He also takes initiative in solving problems early and helps guide teammates toward better outcomes overall consistently.
testimonials.block.items.3.name: Matthew Zhao
testimonials.block.items.3.body: Working with Hieu has been a seamless experience. He is highly responsive, detail-oriented, and always ensures that requirements are clearly understood before execution. His positive and can-do attitude helps drive momentum within the team. He not only meets expectations but often goes the extra mile to suggest improvements that enhance user experience and product value. Additionally, he communicates effectively with stakeholders and contributes to smoother collaboration across teams consistently.
testimonials.block.items.4.name: Benjamin Papillon
testimonials.block.items.4.body:
Hieu was my first engineering hire, and we began discussing working together just weeks after I incorporated the business in the summer of 2021. He built our first website and many critical systems that followed. 
 He has been an incredibly adaptable colleague, partner, and friend. I cannot imagine taking the company from pre-revenue to post Series A without him. We have grown the business nationally and overcome countless challenges together and have delivered results while maintaining strong team culture.
testimonials.block.items.5.name: Nico Martinez
testimonials.block.items.5.body: Hieu combines technical competence with a great team spirit. He is enthusiastic, open to feedback, and continuously seeks ways to improve both his skills and the systems he works on. His structured approach to problem-solving and attention to detail help ensure robust and maintainable solutions. I truly value his contributions and look forward to collaborating with him again on future initiatives while continuing to grow together and deliver strong outcomes across diverse projects and evolving team environments over time.
testimonials.block.items.6.name: Daniel Bailey
testimonials.block.items.6.body: Hieu, it's been a real pleasure getting to know you and working alongside you. You're not only a talented engineer and strong leader, but also an exceptional person. Your mission focus and loyalty to the cause are truly admirable. I'm grateful for the time we've shared and look forward to staying connected. Wishing you all the best on this exciting new chapter ahead, and continued success in everything you pursue moving forward. I appreciate your impact and support always.
